ai.title: A woman was arrested in Philly for blocking a delivery robot
ai.brief: Carolyn Marvin was charged with ‘disorderly conduct’ for protesting delivery robots taking jobs. Carolyn Marvin was charged with ‘disorderly conduct’ for protesting delivery robots taking jobs. Carolyn Marvin was arrested and charged with disorderly conduct after blocking the path of an Uber delivery robot and refusing to get out of the way. ” Police responded to the scene and asked Marvin to move out of the robot’s way. When she refused, they placed her in cuffs and arrested her. The incident was captured on video and has now garnered considerable media attention. The delivery robots have become a common sight on the streets of downtown Philadelphia and have sparked backlash. This is not even Marvin’s first brush with them. And earlier this year, one was kicked over in Center City.

sec.title: Hackers exploit SiteGuard WAF flaw to run commands as admins
sec.brief: Hackers are exploiting an OS command-injection vulnerability in the SiteGuard Server Edition web application firewall (WAF), allowing them to execute commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on affected machines. The security issue is tracked as CVE-2026-106931 and affects the statistics feature in host-based WAF instances, which is enabled by default. 5 million websites . org statistics, the product is active on 500,000 sites. According to the vendor’s bulletin and a warning from Japan's CERT agency, CVE-2026-106931 has critical severity and is currently being exploited in the wild. “An OS command injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-106931) has been found in the statistics function of SiteGuard Server Edition. Abuse has already been confirmed,” reads SiteGuard’s alert . The attacker’s identity, the victims, the scale of the attacks, and the methods used remain unclear, as neither security advisory provides these details.
